title: coincya cheiranthos subsp. montana
intro: Coincya cheiranthos subsp. montana, commonly known as mountain rocket, is a subspecies of plant in the Brassicaceae family. It is a wild mustard plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of mountain rocket include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of antioxidants and omega-3 fatty acids. The bioactive constituents of mountain rocket include glucosinolates, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
